mandate: 설정 메뉴 통합 — 단일 SettingsMenu 패널: SAVE/LOAD(기존 떠다니는 S/L 통합) + SFX 볼륨 슬라이더 + MUSIC 볼륨 슬라이더. 인게임 GuiControlBar gear + MainMenu Options 양쪽서 열기. 볼륨 즉시 AudioBank 반영 + PlayerPrefs 영속. 버튼 fill.raycastTarget=true.
files_in_lane_not_touched: skills/game-prototype/unity-project/Assets/Editor/SceneSetup.UI.cs (CreateIconButton helper already correct; unification handled by SettingsMenu invoking the existing wired SaveBtn/LoadBtn onClick — no edit required)

changes.what: NEW unified settings panel (UITheme MakeBorderedPanel, screen-centered modal).
changes.detail: Contains: ⚙ 설정 header + close(X); SAVE/LOAD row; SFX(사운드) slider; MUSIC(음악) slider. NOT self-bootstrapping — created on demand via EnsureInScene()/Open()/ToggleStatic(), attached to the active scene's Canvas. Because it never auto-spawns it cannot leak onto MainMenu (the 2026-05-30 menu-leak bug class), so GameSceneGate gate is intentionally not used (documented in class header). Save/Load row hides when no GameSaveButtons in scene (MainMenu degrades to pure audio panel). ESC closes ONLY while open (does not consume the in-game ESC=build-cancel binding when closed).

changes.what: SAVE/LOAD reuses existing wired logic (no duplication).
changes.detail: OnSaveClicked/OnLoadClicked call InvokeExistingButton('SaveBtn'/'LoadBtn') which finds the GameSaveButtons host and invokes the canonical SaveBtn/LoadBtn onClick (those buttons own the pawnPrefab/treeSprite SerializeField refs needed for restore). Save has a SaveLoadManager.Save() fallback if host absent. The panel's own buttons are named SettingsSaveBtn/SettingsLoadBtn to avoid colliding with the test-referenced SaveBtn/LoadBtn names.

changes.what: Added SFX + MUSIC master volume (0..1) with PlayerPrefs persistence.
changes.detail: New _sfxVolume/_musicVolume (default 1.0 = day-1 unchanged), public SfxVolume/MusicVolume getters, SetSfxVolume()/SetMusicVolume() apply live to sfxSource (one-shots) and bgm/danger/ambient/rain bed sources then persist to PlayerPrefs keys audio_sfx_volume / audio_music_volume. Prefs loaded in Awake before source setup; Awake/Start/crossfade-targets all scaled by _musicVolume so relative mix (BGM 0.25 < SFX 0.7) preserved at any master. SetMusicVolume respects _dangerActive so dragging mid-raid scales the audible track.

changes.what: Added [설정](⚙ 설정, ESC) gear button at the right end of the bar.
changes.detail: 10th button (was 9): totalW bumped to 10*BtnW + 4*Gap + 5*GroupGap; new VDivider + settingsBtn = MakeBtn('설정','(ESC)', ..., () => SettingsMenu.ToggleStatic(), displayLabel:'⚙ 설정'). GameObject name Btn_설정 (label-derived). Existing 9 button names unchanged. onClick already routes through PlayClickBlip via MakeBtn.
Wired in WireListeners (runtime) and public so SceneSetup bakes a persistent listener. autostart/menushot flow untouched.

changes.what: Added OptionsButton to MainMenu scene; moved Quit down a slot.
changes.detail: Start y=0.45, Options y=0.30 ('Options / 설정'), Quit y=0.15 (was 0.30). SerializedObject wires optionsButton ref; UnityEventTools bakes persistent OnOptionsClicked listener alongside Start/Quit. CreateMenuButton uses a plain Image (raycastTarget default true).

raycast_target: SettingsMenu MakeButton sets the FILL image (Button.targetGraphic) raycastTarget=true explicitly (MakeBorderedPanel defaults fills to false for decorative panels; overridden here since the fill IS the click target). Slider Background + Handle images raycastTarget=true so drag always lands. Labels/text raycastTarget=false.

names_preserved.note: Canonical SaveBtn/LoadBtn (SaveHint lane, out of my lane) left fully intact + functional; SettingsMenu invokes their onClick rather than replacing them. Panel's own buttons use distinct names SettingsSaveBtn/SettingsLoadBtn. GuiControlBar Btn_멈춤..Btn_연구 unchanged; new Btn_설정 added.

lesson_firewall.#4_audio_buzz: n/a — volume setters not in a tight loop; SetSfxVolume/SetMusicVolume only fire on slider drag (onValueChanged).
lesson_firewall.#7_singleton_subscription_race: AudioBank resolved via AudioBank.Instance ?? FindFirstObjectByType (poll/find pattern), cached; no OnEnable event subscription.
lesson_firewall.#9_runInBackground: n/a — no new long WaitForSeconds background timer added. SettingsMenu has no coroutines; AudioBank crossfade coroutine pre-existing/unchanged in timing.
lesson_firewall.menu_leak_class: SettingsMenu deliberately NOT self-bootstrapping (no RuntimeInitializeOnLoadMethod) → cannot spawn on MainMenu uninvited; gate not required, rationale in class header.

out_of_lane_dependencies: GameSaveButtons.cs (SaveHint lane / not edited) — SettingsMenu depends on its SaveBtn/LoadBtn child Button names + wired onClick. If that lane renames those buttons, update InvokeExistingButton args.
SceneSetup.Game.SaveHint.cs (not my lane) still creates the floating S/L corner buttons; they remain visible. If operator wants them removed, that edit belongs to the SaveHint lane owner — flagged.
